Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤔. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but gentle 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
"I don't want to take it. I don't want to be a prisoner in my own mind 🚫."

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need these pills to manage your symptoms 🤯."

JACK:
"I don't need them. I can control my thoughts and feelings on my own 💪."

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, if you won't take them, I'll take them for you 🤷‍♂️."

Dr. Smith forces the pills into Jack's mouth, and Jack swallows, his eyes flashing with defiance 🔥.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a file on his desk 📄. He looks up, and suddenly, Jack is standing in front of him, a confident smile on his face 😊.

JACK:
"Thanks for taking care of me, Doc. I feel much better now 🙏."

DR. SMITH:
"Uh...where did you come from?"

JACK:
"I'm right here. I've been here all along, in your imagination 🤯."

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been seeing Jack, a figment of his own imagination, all along 🤔.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🏥

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring at his reflection in a mirror 📸. He looks at his own eyes, and they seem to be staring back at him, wild and unpredictable 🔮.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) "I'm the one who's been sick all along... 🤯"

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
